author: Zetetic I
title: Fine-Tuning: Reduced Learning Rate for High-Capacity Model
abstract: This experiment investigates the effect of a lower learning rate on the high-capacity model from ID 583. Having established a strong architecture, the focus now shifts to optimization. The hypothesis is that a smaller learning rate (0.0003, down from 0.001) will lead to more stable training and better final convergence for the larger 256-filter model, further improving the overall score.
